title: Dark Energy Survey completes six-year mission
version: 2019-01-08. Joint collaboration announcement hosted by Fermilab.
lineage: Joint collaboration announcement hosted by Fermilab.

passages.note: DES survey mapping began on 31 August 2013 with DECam at the Blanco telescope at Cerro Tololo, Chile. The release anticipated the final night in January 2019 and distinguished ending observations from data analysis.
